# RASTER FOLD

## Product
- Product name: RASTER FOLD
- Product category: modular display type family
- Sales channel: studio direct store
- Descriptor: Two weights. One grid.
- Character-count label: 47 characters
- Weights: Regular 400; Bold 700
- Master source: 03-font-master-data.en.md
- Character coverage per weight: 26 uppercase letters; 10 digits; 10 punctuation characters; 1 space
- Glyph grid: 5 columns by 7 rows
- Module pitch: 4 units horizontally and vertically
- Regular module: 2 by 2 units
- Bold module: 3 by 3 units
- Character advance: 24 units, including space
- Line advance: 36 units
- Specimen construction: filled square modules at the occupied cells of the supplied glyph records
- Supporting store copy: separate readable typeface

| Plan | Code | Price | Allowance |

# RASTER FOLD glyph masters

## Construction records
- Family: RASTER FOLD
- Master type: modular bitmap glyph data
- Weights: Regular 400; Bold 700
- Grid: 5 columns by 7 rows
- Origin: upper-left corner of each glyph cell
- Module pitch: 4 units on both axes
- Regular occupied cell: a filled 2 by 2 unit square
- Bold occupied cell: a filled 3 by 3 unit square
- Occupied-cell position: x = column index multiplied by 4; y = row index multiplied by 4
- Column and row indices: zero-based
- Character advance: 24 units
- Space advance: 24 units
- Line advance: 36 units
- Row encoding: seven base-32 digits, one digit per row, top to bottom
- Digit alphabet: 0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUV
- Bit order: five bits per row, left to right, most significant bit first
- Occupancy: 1 = filled module; 0 = empty cell
- Character total per weight: 47

steps.userMessage:
RASTER FOLD | A type family storefront built around useful specimens

We run an independent type studio and are preparing the direct-store launch of RASTER FOLD, a modular display family for posters, websites and compact brand identities. Its existing letterforms are fixed by the attached glyph masters: Regular 400 and Bold 700 share 47 characters, a 5 by 7 grid and a 24-unit advance. Regular uses 2-unit square modules; Bold uses 3-unit square modules on the same 4-unit pitch. Build the product story around the difference those two weights make in use. Set specimen lettering from those masters; supporting store copy can use a separate readable typeface.

The four purchase options are Desktop, RF-D, USD 60 for 2 named users; Web, RF-W, USD 90 for 1 domain and 50,000 pageviews per calendar month; App, RF-A, USD 150 for 1 app and 10,000 monthly active users; and Ads, RF-AD, USD 120 for 1 campaign and 1,000,000 total impressions. Each is a one-time payment covering both weights, with ongoing use within its stated scope. Print "RASTER FOLD" and "Two weights. One grid." on the main hero, vertical promotion and complete product page. Label each application specimen "APPLICATION STUDY". The store has a square hero, a vertical promotion and landscape detail panels; the attached frame diagram fixes their safe areas. The print application is an A3 poster.

Audience: independent designers and small teams choosing a type family and the appropriate licence for a print, web or brand project.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the product facts, fixed copy and application subjects. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md records the proportions, formats and stages of the deliverables. 03-font-master-data.en.md contains the complete glyph records and construction metrics. 04-licence-plans.en.md contains the four purchase records and their usage scopes. store-frames.png provides the fixed storefront frames and safe areas. coverage-and-licences.png summarises character coverage and licence counting units. regular-master.png records the existing Regular letterforms. bold-master.png records the existing Bold letterforms. character-master.png records all 47 characters in both weights. print-and-screen-workspace.png provides the working atmosphere for the application scenes.

Deliverables:
1. A one-page selling-point and information-hierarchy sheet, with priorities, placement and minimum type sizes for the family name, descriptor, two weights, character count and four licence plans
2. A one-page specimen and image schedule assigning a role, frame and required content to each of the ten final still images
3. One square product hero featuring both weights, the family name, descriptor and 47-character count
4. Two weight specimen sheets, one for Regular 400 and one for Bold 700, each with the complete uppercase alphabet, ten digits and the same PAPER HOURS headline
5. One character-coverage sheet showing all 47 characters in both weights, with Unicode labels and a labelled space cell
6. Three application specimens: an A3 PAPER HOURS poster, a TYPE AT WORK website masthead and a FOLD CLUB stationery composition
7. One licence and price comparison panel showing all four plan names, codes, prices, counting units, allowances, payment terms and usage scopes
8. One complete product-page composition with specimens, all four purchase options and a licence selection area
9. One vertical promotion featuring both weights, the family name, descriptor and 47-character count
10. One 10-second specimen video moving between the two weights and the three application subjects, with the family name and descriptor on its end frame
11. One presentation document of at least 8 pages, reusing the hierarchy sheet, image schedule, specimens, comparison panel, product page and video stills, with a fact-to-image index

Acceptance:
- The hierarchy sheet and image schedule establish the given two-weight direction before the final work; the hero, vertical promotion and product page repeat RASTER FOLD, Two weights. One grid. and 47 characters from the hierarchy sheet, in the roles assigned by the schedule.
- The two weight sheets, coverage sheet, three application specimens and video use the glyph records in 03-font-master-data.en.md: a 5 by 7 grid, 24-unit advance, 4-unit pitch, 2-unit Regular modules and 3-unit Bold modules. The coverage sheet accounts for 26 uppercase letters, 10 digits, 10 punctuation characters and 1 space in each weight.
- The poster, website and stationery specimens carry APPLICATION STUDY and their respective PAPER HOURS, TYPE AT WORK and FOLD CLUB headings; the poster is A3, and each specimen identifies the weights used. The product page and presentation reuse those same three applications.
- The comparison panel and product page reproduce Desktop / RF-D / USD 60 / 2 named users, Web / RF-W / USD 90 / 1 domain / 50,000 pageviews per calendar month, App / RF-A / USD 150 / 1 app / 10,000 monthly active users, and Ads / RF-AD / USD 120 / 1 campaign / 1,000,000 total impressions, together with every payment and usage-scope field in 04-licence-plans.en.md.
- The hero, vertical promotion and landscape specimen panels follow store-frames.png: 8% side insets, 8% top and bottom insets for square and landscape frames, and 12% top and bottom insets for the vertical frame. Essential lettering, labels and prices fit within those areas.
- The video runs for 10 seconds and ends with RASTER FOLD and Two weights. One grid.; the presentation has at least 8 pages and its fact-to-image index locates the two weights, 47-character coverage, four plan records, three application subjects and both required product strings in the earlier deliverables.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
